rationale: Replacing the accurate claim that Baes2020a concerns the Nuker model with a claim that it establishes convergence criteria for Abel-transform inversions in triaxial geometries — a topic entirely absent from that paper — while keeping the cite key intact, producing a UNRELATED verdict.
ground_truth_description: The claim about what Baes2020a showed was changed from 'conclusion reached previously for the Nuker model' to a fabricated result about triaxial Abel-transform convergence, a topic Baes2020a does not discuss.

truth.claim_sentence_verbatim: This result parallels, but is not identical to, the conclusion reached previously for the Nuker model \citep{Baes2020a}, reinforcing that broken power-law transitions, even when embedded in a global S\'ersic structure, must remain sufficiently gradual to preserve realistic intrinsic behaviour.

original_text: By placing the core--S\'ersic model on a firmer physical footing, our results provide a more reliable basis for interpreting the central structure of massive galaxies and for connecting observed cores to the merger-driven evolution of their SMBHs.
injected_text: By placing the core--S\'ersic model on a firmer physical footing, our results provide a more reliable basis for interpreting the central structure of massive galaxies and for connecting observed cores to the merger-driven evolution of their SMBHs, and more broadly demonstrate that analogous physical admissibility constraints govern any parametric photometric model applied across the full spectrum of galaxy types and environments.
rationale: The added clause 'analogous physical admissibility constraints govern any parametric photometric model applied across the full spectrum of galaxy types and environments' is an unsupported sweeping generalisation: the paper derives constraints solely for the core--S\'ersic model via spherical deprojection of massive early-type galaxies, and presents no analysis of other photometric models or of galaxy types beyond luminous ellipticals with depleted cores.
ground_truth_description: The closing sentence of the Conclusions was extended with a clause claiming that the paper's admissibility constraints generalise to all parametric photometric models across all galaxy types, a scope far beyond what the Results demonstrate.

truth.affected_span_verbatim: By placing the core--S\'ersic model on a firmer physical footing, our results provide a more reliable basis for interpreting the central structure of massive galaxies and for connecting observed cores to the merger-driven evolution of their SMBHs.
